surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse, diffuse grey-pixel clusters are concentrated around the blowhole and intermittently along the central longitudinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, soft-edged gradients between the primary light surface and the darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, fine-line longitudinal striations on the right dorsal flank; a single dark circular mark is visible posterior-lateral to the blowhole.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, raised longitudinal ridge begins mid-body and extends posteriorly, casting a sharp, high-contrast shadow onto the left side of the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint longitudinal linear striations on the right dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A clearly defined, dark circular blowhole aperture is visible on the anterior dorsal surface.
